meta.name: baoyu-url-to-markdown
meta.description: Fetch any URL and convert to markdown using Chrome CDP. Supports two modes - auto-capture on page load, or wait for user signal (for pages requiring login). Use when user wants to save a webpage as markdown.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将任意网页转为 Markdown 格式保存
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要把网页内容保存为 Markdown 格式
copy.tagline_en: Convert any webpage to Markdown format
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to save web pages as Markdown

howto.what: 抓取指定网页,用 Chrome 渲染后转成带网址、标题等元数据的 Markdown,也支持等用户确认后再抓取。
howto.when: 当你想把某个网页保存成 Markdown 时触发,比如给出网址或要求保存页面;也用于需要登录、慢加载的网页。

say.text: 把 https://example.com 保存成 Markdown
say.note: 直接抓取并生成 md 文件

say.text: 用等待模式保存这个需要登录的页面
say.note: 页面就绪后按回车抓取

say.text: 将 https://example.com 保存为 output.md

howto.what_en: Claude can fetch a URL via Chrome CDP, render JavaScript, and convert the page to clean Markdown with metadata (URL, title, etc.). It also supports waiting for user confirmation before capturing.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user wants to save a webpage as Markdown, such as providing a URL or requesting a page save, especially for login-required or slow-loading pages.

say_en.text: Use wait mode to save this login-required page
